Commentary.Commentary: The ground might be small, but Windies weren't all that great with the ball. They lacked innovation and weren't supported in the field at all. Their mishaps from the previous game came to haunt them, and as a result, they paid the price for it. Dropped Babar Azam of all people and then he went on to score almost 20 more runs after that. The visitors will have to come out firing from the word go. A good start is key. Join us in a bit for the second half.

Another excellent total posted on the board by Pakistan. They've bettered their performance with the bat from yesterday and registered their highest-ever total in T20Is. Fakhar Zaman departed early but Babar Azam and the newbie Hussain Talat took things in their stride and powered a 119-run stand to set it all up. Shoaib Malik later came in and then along with Babar, ensured Pakistan crossed the 200-mark yet again. The latter might have missed out on his ton, but he played a superb knock yet again.

No he doesn't. But has played really well to take Pakistan to 205. Full ball on the legs of Azam who cannot flick it well enough for a boundary. The ball rolls to the short fine leg region where he can only pick up a run. PAKISTAN END WITH 205-3 AFTER 20 OVERS.
Short ball outside off, Azam finds the fielder at point. Still on 96, can he get to the three digit mark?
Malik taps it around the corner and gives Azam the strike. Pakistan now cross their highest ever T20I score.
Frustrated Azam after he finds the fielder at short third man. Moves to the other end with this.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Azam pulls it in the gap through mid-wicket for a boundary. Pakistan get to 200 with this and Azam moves to 95.
Full on leg, Babar flicks it through square leg for a brace. Moves to the nervous nineties with this.
Full around off, Azam drives this towards mid off for one.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
SIX! Paul misses his yorker, Malik gets under this and lofts this over mid on for a biggie.
Slow bouncer from Paul. Malik tries to pull this but fails to connect.
Short again around off, Azam pulls this front of square for one.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Azam plays it with an angled bat and guides it through the third man region for a boundary.
Keemo Paul comes to bowl the second-last over.
FOUR! Short and wide again! Malik upper cuts this over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
The batsman plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
Short and wide, Azam tries to cut but misses.

Five Wides! Poor bowling from Emrit. Completely missed his line. This one lands way down the leg side and even three keepers wouldn't get to that. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length again, Shoaib hops and fends this on the off side for a run.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on the pads of Malik who nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary.

NOT OUT! That ball would have clipped the leg stump but the on-field call of not out stands. Emrit serves this full on leg, Azam tries to dig out the yorker but cannot get bat to it. The ball hits his ankle area and rolls towards short the third man region. The bowlers appeal but the umpire stays put. Jason Mohammed has a talk with Emrit and decides to take it up. Hawk Eye shows that the ball would have clipped the leg stump. Azam stays and so does the review of Windies.
An appeal for LBW is referred upstairs. Babar Azam is the man in question. Is this going to miss the leg stump?
Shoaib Malik is the next man in.

OUT! Short ball on middle, it rushes into Ali who is a little late on his pull. The ball skies towards deep mid-wicket where Walton hares in and takes a good catch. Ali departs trying to up the scoring.
Full on the pads of Azam who flicks it away to deep square leg for a run.
Azam drives this through covers and will get two for it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

DROPPED! It doesn't get easier than this! Slow ball around off, Azam goes for the flick but gets a top edge to this. The ball flies towards the short fine leg region where Badree gets under it. He gets his hands in position and drops a dolly. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Full ball on middle, Azam lofts this over mid on for a biggie. The umpire raises his arms in the air to signal the result.
Kesrick Williams comes back for another spell.
Another pull shot but this time Azam will only get one for it as the ball goes towards mid-wicket.
Short again outside off, Ali cuts it over covers this time. The fielder does well to save the boundary. The batsmen cross.
SIX! Gets this off the meat and the ball flies over mid-wicket. Effort ball again from Smith outside off, Ali connects with his pull for half a dozen.
Short again and Azam pulls this front of square for one this time.
Digs this one short, Azam pulls this with muscle through mid-wicket for a brace.
Slow length ball around off, Ali looks to slap this on the off side but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Up and over and the ball finds the fence. Full around off, Azam plays the inside-out shot over covers for another boundary. 68 off 40 now is Babar. 5 overs left in this innings.
Full in line of the stumps, Ali drives this uppishly to the mid off region and picks up a single.
FOUR! Short ball outside off and this time Ali upper cuts it over the third man fielder for a boundary.
Ali guides this to the short third man fielder for a dot. A yard on any side and that was a boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Outside off and cuts this once again in the gap. Length ball, Azam opens the face of his bat and places it in the gap for another boundary.
Asif Ali comes in next to bat.

OUT! Smith gets his first T20I wicket! Serves this short outside off, Talat makes room and looks to cut it over backward point. Jason Mohammed the fielder there, times his jump to perfection to collect this. A wonderful innings from Talat comes to an end.
FOUR! Overpitched ball outside off, Talat gets low and lofts this over mid off for a lovely boundary. The timing on that was just amazing.
Azam plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Drags his length back a bit and angles this into the hips of Talat who misses his pull shot. The ball hits him and rolls to the off side where they pick up a leg bye.
Talat just manages to keep the yorker out. Good ball bowled by Smith.
Length ball outside off, Talat slices this over point and another good work in the deep restricts the batsmen to two.
Odean Smith comes back into the attack.
Yorker again. Babar guides this to the short third man fielder for a dot.
Azam has done well to keep that yorker at bay.

Finally a good piece of work on the boundary rope. This ball is wide outside off, Azam cuts it in the gap and will only get two. The umpire checks if the fielder has touched the rope while tidying up the ball but has done well to save a couple of runs.
Full in line of the stumps, Talat hits it down the ground but a good effort from the bowler restricts the run to one as the ball goes away from him to the off side.
Full again on middle and leg, Babar hits it along the turf to long on for one.
FOUR! Misses his yorker and bowls this full around off, Azam gets on one knee and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full ball around off, Talat gets it off the inner half through mid on for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Runs continue to flow for Pakistan. Length ball down the leg, Talat just helps it on its way for a boundary.
Yorker from Powell. Talat gets his bat down in time to dig it out.
Maiden T20I fifty for Talat! What a moment for the youngster. On the pads again, Hussain works it through square leg for a brace. Takes his helmet off in celebration and acknowledges the crowd.

FOUR! Poor fielding from the Windies. Saw this in the first match and nothing seems to have gotten better. Full ball on middle, Talat whips this to the deep mid-wicket region. Walton the fielder there gets low but the ball goes through him for a boundary.
Babar flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Talat square cuts this perfectly in the gap for a boundary. Pakistan cross the 100 mark and look good for a big score.
Fifty for Azam! His fourth in T20Is. Taps this with soft hands towards point and runs to the other end to get to his landmark.
Slow again, on the stumps, Azam defends this from within the crease.
FOUR! Strays this down the leg side, Azam works this to the fine leg region for a boundary. Moves to 49 now.
Full on middle and leg, Talat makes room and lofts it over covers for just one.
Slow ball down leg, Azam helps it on its way for one.
Length ball outside off, Azam cuts it past backward point for a run. Pakistan 90/1 after 10 overs.
FOUR! Short slow ball on middle, Azam pulls this towards mid-wicket and after a poor effort from the fielder there, the ball crosses the rope for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Length ball around off, Azam cuts it deliberately fine of the short third man fielder for another boundary.
Full outside off, Talat slices this to deep point to give his partner the strike.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Talat cuts it fine to the third man region for a boundary.
Back of a length ball, Azam plays this with soft hands towards covers for a run.
FOUR! In the gap this time. Short and wide outside off, Talat cuts it in the gap through point for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Finds the fielder again. Overpitched ball and Talat drives it superbly to the man at covers.
Bangs this one short outside off, Talat tries to upper cut it but doesn't get bat to ball.
Pitched up again, Azam drives this towards mid off and this time picks up a run.
Wide. The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Full delivery outside off, Azam leans forward and drives this to the mid off fielder.
Digs this one short, Azam pulls it in front of square for just a single though. He is unhappy after hitting it as he found the fielder there.
Drags his length back, Talat taps this towards point for a run.
Full again on off, Azam drives this to covers for one more.
Bowls this fuller on the pads, Talat flicks it towards square leg for one.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Almost gets a wicket on his debut! Back of a length ball outside off, Talat looks to cut this but gets an inside edge to it. The ball misses the leg stump and goes towards fine leg which allows them pick up a run.
Odean Smith gets to bowl his first over.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard. That ball kept low outside off, Azam crouches low and cuts it in the gap through point for a boundary. This also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Around off, Talat pushes this to covers for one more.
Pitched up on middle, Azam hits this to the mid on fielder and gets to the other end.
Short ball outside off, Talat rocks back and punches this towards mid off for one.
This one skids off the surface. Bowls this outside off, Talat gets low to cut it but misses.
Gives this air, Talat plays this through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Azam just showing his class here. Back of a length ball outside off, Babar hangs back and cuts it through cover-point for another boundary. 54/1 now after 6 overs. A good Powerplay for the hosts. The loss of Fakhar Zaman has not affected them.
The batsman has played it towards the point region. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Full outside off, Talat lofts this over mid on for a boundary.
Poor fielding from Samuels. Length ball outside off, Talat drives this to cover-point and Marlon who is lazy in getting down, allows the ball to go through him. The batsmen pick up two for it.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On a good length around off, Azam plays this to the cover fielder for nothing.
Kesrick Williams comes into the attack.
Slow outside off, Azam charges down and hits this towards mid on for one.
Pitched up, Talat works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one outside off, Talat square cuts this to the fielder at point.
SIX! Not afraid to come down the pitch to Badree and smokes this for a biggie. Bowls this slower through the air outside off, Talat dances down and hits this over extra cover for a maximum.
FOUR! Cute from Talat. Slow ball on the stumps, Talat gets low and paddles this down the fine leg region for a boundary.
Floated ball on middle, Talat charges down but decides to defend it.
Back of a length ball on off, Talat opens the face of his bat and guides this to point for another run.
Length outside off, Azam goes on his back foot and taps it towards mid off for a run.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now and this one is the best of the lot. Pitched up ball on off, Azam drives this through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Azam. Emrit pitches this full on leg, Azam helps it on its way to the wide fine leg region for a boundary.
Short and wide again, Azam tries a similar shot but fails to put bat to ball.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Azam cuts it past backward point for a boundary.
Drags his length back, Talat rocks back and punches it on the off side nothing.
Darts this in line of the sumps and Talat plays in onto the ground.
In the air... but safe. Quicker one outside off, Talat slices this between backward point and the gully region. The ball doesn't have the legs to go all the way but they pick up two for it.
Gives this one air too, Talat drives this to the cover fielder and after a misfield from the Windies skipper, the ball rolls further which allows them to pick up two runs.
Tosses this one up, Azam milks this through mid on for a run.
Starts by bowling one flat outside off, Azam taps it to the off side.
Samuel Badree to roll his arm now.
Outside off again, another play and miss from Talat. Good over from Emrit.
Slower ball outside off, Talat flirts with it but misses. The keeper collects it on the bounce.
Hussain Talat walks in next to bat.

OUT! The dangerous Fakhar Zaman departs. Emrit bangs this one short down the leg side. Zaman goes for the hook shot but fails to connect it cleanly. While doing so, he just manages to glove it to Ramdin who takes it at a good height. The players appeal and up goes the umpire's finger. They are all smiles now as Fakhar fails to give that explosive start.
Length again on off, invites Azam for the drive who taps it with soft hands towards mid off and quickly gets to the other end.
Good length ball around off, Azam shuffles across and places it well enough through mid-wicket for a brace.
Bowls this full on leg, Zaman works it to square leg to move to the other end.
Rayad Emrit will bowl from the other end.
Strays this on the pads of Azam, who whips it away to the deep square leg region for a couple of runs to end the first over.
Pitches this up as well, Azam gets low and drives this to the fielder at mid off.
Pitched up around leg, Fakhar flicks this through square leg for a single.
FOUR! First boundary of the day and it is from the bat of Fakhar. Overpitched ball around off, Zaman leans forward and smacks It in the gap through cover-point for a boundary.
Slightly fuller this time, in line of the stumps, Zaman hits this to the mid on fielder for nothing.
Starts by bowling from round the wicket and lands this on a good length on middle and leg. It angles into him and Fakhar hits this towards mid-wicket.

We are ready to begin as the players and the umpires make their way out in the middle. Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman will open the innings for Pakistan, while Keemo Paul will take the ball first up. Let's go!

Jason Mohammed says they will try to be competitive in this game and be positive. One forced change as Odean Smith (debut) comes in for the injured Veerasammy Permaul. Mentions he and his side feel a little better now so are up for the challenge. Ends by saying he wants to lead from the front and set an example.

Sarfraz Ahmed says they will bat first. Adds it's a good wicket, so wants to put a good score on the board and then defend it. States his side is unchanged and if they are in a good position, they will shuffle the batting order.

Rameez Raja is down for the pitch report. He says that there are a few cracks along with a few green patches of grass. He adds by saying that the track is warm and good for batting. He ends by saying that he will give the pitch five stars and reckons that it will be another long day for the bowlers.
TOSS - Pakistan win the toss and will bat first!

For Pakistan, cricket has returned to Karachi after nine long years and they are surely making the most of it. The crowd came out in good numbers yesterday and the players didn't disappoint them a bit. Pakistan outclassed the visitors in all departments yesterday and will hope for the same performance today as well. We all expect the Windies to come stronger and harder at the hosts today. Should be a good contest.

The first game between these two saw Pakistan achieve their joint-highest T20I score while the Windies got their lowest. Interestingly, both sides do not have a day's break to analyze their game, something that Jason Mohammed's men will need more than their counterparts. The jet lagged Windies team will have to get their act together as quickly as possible if they want to make a mark on this tour. To make matters worse, they will be without their spinner, Veerasammy Permaul, who twisted his ankle in the course of the first match. With not much experience in their ranks, they will hope that their seniors come good and put aside all the critics which they had to face.
